text: So yeah, I got back home. I got back to college from home this Sunday.

But I'm like taking a class called deep learning, which I've been wanting to take since a really, really long time.

And I ended up like trying that class out and I liked it. And then I was supposed to like take another class called human-robot interaction. And I went to attend that class, but I didn't really like the vibes that much. There was a lot of like in-class work that had to be done, which I wasn't a huge fan of.
I like being at home and just doing work at home.
So, I didn't really like it.
But there was another class that I tried out, which was called sketching and indexing.
And that class was being taught by Benjamin Lambead, who's actually my faculty advisor.
And he's just so amazing.

And so, I got to take his class for the first time ever in four years, which is so ironic because every semester whenever I meet him for my advising meeting, I tell him that, oh, you know, like he teaches two classes.

One of them is called sketching and indexing. And the other one is called computational genomics, I think. And I always tell him that, oh, I'm like planning on taking your class, but I'll try it out and see if like another class works for me.
And I never end up taking it.
But this semester, I think I like that class more than the other class that I was actually planning on taking.
So, I'm going to take sketching and indexing.

And it's just such an interesting topic and something that is not cliche at all, like machine learning, AI is something that we hear about every day. But this course is about how data is structured, and how like we compress it and index it such that it can be shared like in a faster manner or scale so that it takes lesser time to like compute on it. Like it makes the whole process more efficient. And it's honestly like something that's not talked about that much in like the exact manner that we talked about in that class.
And so, I'm really excited to learn a lot of new things.

And the class is actually based on data structures, contrary to like what you would naturally tend to think about. Like you would think that there will be like many advanced topics, but we're actually just like starting out with hash tables and hash sets, which is like basic data structure.
So, I'm really excited about taking that class.
And yeah, I'm excited to do, this is my last semester. So, there're some things that I've like wanted to do. There's a lot of restaurants on my list that I've yet to try.
And also, I want to do ice skating, because I used to do like speed skating as a child.

All of our families were really good friends, and we were really good friends with each other. And it was just like such an amazing thing for me.
